title: KLM's Ex-CEO Sets Business Class on Fire, Delta Piles Into LAX, and AirAsia Says It's Fine, Actually
summary: A former KLM CEO becomes the star of his own airline's power bank nightmare somewhere over the Atlantic. Plus, Delta goes all in on Los Angeles with its biggest schedule ever, AirAsia insists it's not collapsing despite the government quietly lining up a backup plan, and a private jet broker sits on $150 million of your money while it "reviews things."
